title: Resource Recovery Facility Roof Coating

onscreen_lines.desc: All-inclusive fee for the application of a high-quality roof coating at the Material Recovery Facility (approximately 75,000 sq. ft.). This scope includes roof surface preparation, necessary repairs, materials, application of a rubber roof coating system, and quality assurance as outlined in the Scope of Work. The all-inclusive fee shall cover, but is not limited to, all labor, equipment, materials, travel, lodging, overhead, profit, and any other expenses incurred by the contractor for the completion of this project.
onscreen_lines.note: Vendor(s) are not required to bid on all items. Vendor(s) are allowed to bid on any one particular item within the bid schedule in order to be considered eligible for award. If a Vendor does not intend to place a bid on one particular item, Vendor shall place a No Bid within the bid schedule for that item.
